findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a build up of mold in the soda gun holder at the bar area. Discussed with PIC and the soda gun holder was clean. Ensure that food-contact surfaces are monitored and cleaned to avoid contamination of food items.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11:  Inspector observed ice machine drop guard and soda guns to be soiled with accumulated mold. The items were sanitized at time of inspection. The violation is considered corrected on site. Take care to maintain food contact surfaces properly cleaned and sanitized. This is a repeat violation.

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Cream stored in the walk in cooler is held at 48F. The two quart containers of cream were discarded at time of inspection. The violation is considered corrected on site. Do not store TCS (temperature control for safety food) in the walk in cooler unless it can maintain the food at 41F or below. There are other options for food storage. 

(A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: Inspector observed two quarts of cream open with no date marking. The cream was discarded at time of inspection. Practice proper date marking rules for TCS foods.
(A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: Inspector observed the side of the ice bin to be leaking, and rusted. The non food surface is not smooth or easily cleanable. Repair ice bin by the next routine inspection. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector observed the soda gun holders to be soiled. Clean and maintain them free of accumulated soil. This is a repeat violation.

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The ceiling of the walk in cooler is soiled with mildew and dust. This is a repeat violation.
The floor to the left of the ice machine is soiled with mold. Clean these areas and maintain them free of accumulated soil. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-303.11: There is no light in the walk in cooler. The light intensity shall be: At least 108 lux (10 foot candles) at a distance of 75 cm (30 inches) above the floor in walk-in refrigeration units. 
Provide proper lighting in the walk in cooler.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P 
The Blue Grouch allows AJ’s BBQ to serve food from the facility Friday and Saturday nights and sometimes on Thursdays according to the live music schedule. Food is served by AJ’s approximately 5 times a month. The BBQ facility is listed on the internet as A&B BBQ and Grille at 319 E Madison St. in the Central Building. Licensing information can not be found for this facility. No food from AJ’s is present at this time and the facility is going to discontinue this activity. Make sure to verify the origin of the food served out of the facility. 
A spot check will be conducted to ensure that equipment owned by AJ’s has been removed from the facility.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed no employee health reporting agreements for all food handling employees. Discussed with PIC. PIC was given copies at the pre-opening on 12/20/21. Inspector will follow-up on 2/18/22.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following food-contact areas to no longer be clean:
1. Soda nozzle holders at the bar were all soiled with debris and mildew. This is a repeat violation since 6/9/21.
2. Ice scoop was placed on top of the ice machine without a clean surface to rest upon that can be washed, rinsed, and sanitize. Utilize a scoop holder or plate.

Inspector discussed with PIC. Will follow-up on 2/18/22.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

(REPEAT) Observed the mop to be stored within the mop bucket and not be hung in a manner that allows to drip and/or air dry. Discussed with PIC. COS. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 6/9/21.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Observed both employee’s to improperly wash hands. Employee’s did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet. Use a barrier such as a paper towel. Discussed proper hand washing technique. COS.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Observed ice to be dumped into the hand sink. Hand sinks must be utilized for only hand washing. Cease practice. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed multiple soda nozzle holders and soda nozzles to have accumulation of mold. Discussed wash, rinse, and sanitize routinely with PIC. Employee began to clean during inspection. COS.

Observed the pizza ovens to have accumulation of food splash and debris. Ensure routine cleaning. Inspector asked employee’s to clean ovens during inspection. COS.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements. 

Observed the incorrect type of bleach being utilized for the three compartment sink. Bleach was not for food-contact surfaces. Discussed appropriate bleach type with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 6/14/21.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. 

(REPEAT) Observed back door to be a sliding door and not self-closing. Facility has not created a policy indicating that the door should be closed between uses. Policy not posed by door. This is a repeat violation since the pre-opening on 6/2/20.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following areas still in need of repairs:
1. Seal the entrance/interior frame into the walk-in cooler. Paint can be used as seal.

Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection. This is a repeat violation since the pre-opening on 6/2/20.
